title: V is the graph measure of its tangent planes (printed (1)–(2) of the proof of 1.2, corrected η_V^(x)(β) = β(T_x))
statement: Let V be an n-varifold on U ⊆ ℝ^N and suppose η : ℝ^N → Measure(G(N,n)) satisfies the conclusions of Simon Ch. 8, Lemma 1.3 (the sibling plane_disintegration): for μ_V-a.e. x, η(x) is a probability measure and (∫_{Gₙ(B_ρ(x))} β(S) dV)/μ_V(B_ρ(x)) → ∫ β dη(x) as ρ ↓ 0 for every continuous β on G(N,n); and ∫⁻_{Gₙ(A)} β(S) dV = ∫⁻_A ∫⁻ β dη(x) dμ_V(x) for Borel A ⊆ ℝ^N and continuous β ≥ 0. If V has a tangent plane in the sense of Def. 1.1 at μ_V-a.e. x, then for every Borel A ⊆ ℝ^N × G(N,n) the set S_A := {x : ∃ T θ, HasTangentPlane V x T θ ∧ (x, T) ∈ A} is μ_V-null-measurable and V(A) = μ_V(S_A).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (V : Varifold N n U), (∃ η : Euclidean N → Measure (Grassmannian N n), (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, IsProbabilityMeasure (η x) ∧ ∀ β : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ), Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ (∫ z in closedBall x ρ ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), β z.2 ∂V.measure) / (V.weight (closedBall x ρ)).toReal) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (∫ S, β S ∂(η x)))) ∧ ∀ (A : Set (Euclidean N)) (β : C(Grassmannian N n, ℝ)), MeasurableSet A → (∀ S, 0 ≤ β S) → ∫⁻ z in A ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), ENNReal.ofReal (β z.2) ∂V.measure = ∫⁻ x in A, (∫⁻ S, ENNReal.ofReal (β S) ∂(η x)) ∂V.weight) → (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ) → ∀ A : Set (Euclidean N × Grassmannian N n), MeasurableSet A → NullMeasurableSet {x | ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ ∧ (x, T) ∈ A} V.weight ∧ V.measure A = V.weight {x | ∃ (T : Grassmannian N n) (θ : ℝ), HasTangentPlane V x T θ ∧ (x, T) ∈ A}
